title: SPECIAL TOPICS: ST/ DANCE: COUNTRY SWING I
rpt_for_credit: This course is repeatable for 11 credits
clssnotes:
PREQ: PAC 154: Country Western I or extensive Country Western Swing experience. Focuses on leading and following principles for modern country swing with emphasis on settle, stretch, and compression. Expanding modern country swing repertoire and addressing how to utilize traditional swing movements in modern swing.
